content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Guides gumroad

The digital commerce landscape is dominated by platforms like Stripe and PayPal, which exclude a significant portion of the world. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, leaving creators in many regions without access to essential payment processing tools. This exclusion creates a barrier for digital creators looking to sell products online. Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a structural alternative, allowing creators to regain control over their sales processes. By deploying independent stacks, creators can establish their own online stores, collect payments directly, and maintain full ownership of their data without relying on third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure consists of various free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. For instance, the Edge Commerce Stack utilizes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Workers for backend logic, and Supabase for order storage. These components operate collectively to create a robust digital storefront that supports automatic crypto payment processing through NOWPayments. This architecture eliminates reliance on conventional payment platforms, giving creators the ability to sell their digital products freely and securely. With features like instant product delivery and data ownership, creators can focus on what matters most: their content.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan often face challenges that prevent creators from easily selling digital products. This system is for those who want to bypass the limitations imposed by platforms like Stripe and PayPal and instead establish a fully operational online store. It empowers creators by enabling them to sell their products without the fear of frozen accounts or payment delays, ensuring they can monetize their work effectively.
Create your own infrastructure, avoid reliance on third-party platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of this sovereign commerce infrastructure lies in its interconnected components. Each part serves a distinct role: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This synergy creates a powerful system that is not only affordable but also scalable. By utilizing these tools, creators can set up their online presence quickly and efficiently, with low overhead costs and no hidden fees, ensuring that they keep more of their earnings.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Getting started with your sovereign commerce stack is straightforward. First, choose the Edge Commerce Stack to leverage advanced features and support. Next, set up your hosting on Cloudflare Pages, followed by configuring your backend using Cloudflare Workers. Integrate an order management system with Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, connect NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. The entire setup can be completed in 48 hours, setting you on the path to selling your digital products independently.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can still sell digital products by utilizing sovereign commerce infrastructure. This allows you to create your own online store with tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, bypassing conventional platforms altogether. This approach ensures that you maintain control over your products and payments.
Keep 100% of your earnings with low transaction fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

PayPal may not be a viable option in these countries due to account restrictions and suspensions. Instead, consider using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments for more reliable transactions.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low 0.5% fee for processing transactions. This is significantly more affordable than traditional payment processors, allowing creators to retain more of their earnings.

You can deploy your store using the Edge Commerce Stack within 48 hours. This quick setup allows you to start selling your digital products without delay.
